title: PC-CROP Federal Accounting — database guard for integration telemetry
purpose: Stack a database-level fail-closed guard on PR #4423 so another current or future writer cannot bypass the service redaction and insert raw request/response/error text into IntegrationEvent. Existing historical rows are not rewritten in this slice: constraints are NOT VALID, so new/updated rows are enforced immediately while historical cleanup remains a separately governed retention/legal-hold decision.
boundaries: This slice is stacked on PR #4423 and relies on its metadata-only writer/read projection.
No historical integration event row is deleted, rewritten or claimed sanitized here.
The new CHECK constraints are NOT VALID: they enforce every new or updated row immediately but do not retroactively reject existing historical evidence before a governed cleanup decision.
No second event/audit/outbox store is created.
No Prisma data model field is added; this is database integrity over the existing IntegrationEvent shape.
No application secret, provider credential, apps/web, auth, banking, FGIS, hosting or production mutation.
Merge and green CI are not production acceptance.
requiredInvariants: New requestPayload/responsePayload values are either SQL NULL or one exact structural metadata object kind emitted by PR #4423.
New errorMessage values are either SQL NULL or a bounded uppercase machine-safe code.
A direct Prisma/raw SQL writer attempting to insert an arbitrary object/string/array into requestPayload or responsePayload is refused by PostgreSQL.
A direct writer attempting to persist free-text exception detail is refused by PostgreSQL.
Historical rows remain readable through PR #4423's metadata-only projection while their separate cleanup decision is pending.
requiredChecks: prisma migrate deploy + drift check through existing PC-CROP accounting acceptance because migration name contains _pc_crop_
